purpose: The prompt-prefix cache never stored anything when the Metal GPU-resident prefill drove the prompt, because `store_prompt_prefix_cache` requires `cpu_kv_authoritative()` and a resident prefill leaves the CPU KV buffers empty. That is the lane PR #556 makes automatic, so every repeated or growing chat prompt re-prefilled from scratch. This receipt measures mirroring the GPU history back at store time, gated on the round trip being bit-exact.

host.note: Shared desktop, not an isolated bench host; arms run back to back.

source.changed_commit: 6d1adb36171bbdd66f51640ca3574d805e87c0bc (+ uncommitted working tree at measurement time)
source.environment: env -i HOME PATH only, except where an arm names a variable.

method: camelid serve --no-open, wait for generation_ready, then POST the SAME 1974-token chat completion three times with stream=true and max_tokens=1 so prefill dominates; wall time of the complete SSE response, via curl %{time_total}.

parity.method: Same prompt, greedy, max_tokens=32, non-streaming, three turns per binary; sha256 of the completion text.
parity.verdict: Byte-identical across cold and cached turns and across both binaries. The exactness argument holds in practice: the CPU KV stores f16-rounded values, so an F16 primary resident cache round-trips unchanged.

scope.covered: Q4_K/Q6_K models, whose resident KV defaults to an F16 primary.
scope.not_covered: Q8_0 models keep an F32 primary resident cache; mirroring would f16-round it, so they are refused and still re-prefill. Quantized CPU KV (--kv-quant q8_0|q4_0) is refused for the same reason. The CUDA resident lane is excluded at the call sites, unchanged.
scope.cost: This lane's CPU KV goes from zero bytes to full size, and store_prompt_prefix_cache clones it, so a cached entry costs roughly two CPU KV copies of one prompt. The pool holds one entry by default and ensure_position_capacity still enforces the session KV budget; CAMELID_PREFIX_CACHE_RESIDENT=0 opts out.
